in_sanskrit.name: Gopal
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gopal is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Gau' (cow) and 'Pal' (protector). It means 'protector of cows' or 'cowherd'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as Gopal, as he is believed to have protected the cows and the villagers of Vrindavan.

in_hindi.name: Ramgopal
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's footsteps
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ramgopal एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ram means God and Gopal means one who protects. Ramgopal thus signifies the footsteps of God or God in human form, protecting and guiding the devotee.

in_tamil.name: Ramgopal
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God's footsteps
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ramgopal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Ram means God and Gopal means one who protects. Ramgopal thus signifies the footsteps of God or God in human form, protecting and guiding the devotee.

in_telugu.name: Ramgopal
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ramgopal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Ram means God and Gopal means one who protects. Ramgopal thus signifies the footsteps of God or God in human form, protecting and guiding the devotee.

in_marathi.name: Ramgopal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramgopal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means God and Gopal means one who protects. Ramgopal thus signifies the footsteps of God or God in human form, protecting and guiding the devotee.

in_bengali.name: Ramgopal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's footsteps
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramgopal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ram means God and Gopal means one who protects. Ramgopal thus signifies the footsteps of God or God in human form, protecting and guiding the devotee.
